unavailable.title: Not available here
unavailable.body: This copy of the site runs without a database, so rooms and rankings are turned off.

profile.label: Display name
profile.invalid: Pick a name with at least one letter.
profile.title: Profile
profile.nicknameHint: Nobody else can have the same one. 3 to 20 letters, digits or _.
profile.nicknameInvalid: A nickname has 3 to 20 lower case letters, digits or _.
profile.streak: {count, plural, =0 {No streak right now} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}. Longest: {best}.

race.label: Race, room {code}
race.giveUpBody: You keep the rounds you solved and go to the table. You cannot come back to this race.
race.rules: Each hint adds 30 seconds to your time. A revealed puzzle counts as not solved.
race.revealBody: The puzzle solves itself and counts as not solved. Whoever solved more rounds finishes ahead, whatever the time.
race.roundSaved: Round done. Next one coming up.
race.more: {count, plural, one {and # more player} other {and # more players}}

room.title: Challenge room
room.missingBody: Rooms last a day and a half. Ask for a new link, or open a room of your own.
room.over: This race is over. Here is how it went.
room.inviteBody: Send the link. Everyone who opens it lands in this room.
room.shareText: Race me on Minigames: {rounds, plural, one {# puzzle} other {# puzzles}}, same boards for everyone.
room.startAlone: You can start alone, or wait for someone to join.
room.clockNote: Your clock starts when your first board appears and only stops when your last round is done, even if you leave the page.
room.waitingOthers: You are done. The others are still racing.

setup.title: Challenge friends
setup.blurb: Open a room, pick the puzzles and send the link. Everyone gets the same boards and races to finish them.
setup.failed: The room could not be opened. Try again.
setup.tooMany: Too many rooms in the last hour. Try again later.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.empty: Nobody has scored yet. Solve a daily puzzle to open the ranking.
ranking.rulesPoints: Daily puzzles only: 100 points for solving, minus 10 per hint, plus up to 50 for speed. Practice and challenge rooms do not count. A week runs from Monday to Sunday.
ranking.rulesTime: Fastest solves of today's puzzle. Each hint counts as 30 seconds.
ranking.hubEmpty: No scores this week yet. The first daily puzzle solved takes the lead.
ranking.challengeBody: Race the same puzzles against friends, live.
ranking.profileHint: Pick your name, or sign in with a passkey

account.deviceTitle: This player lives on this device
account.deviceBody: Your name, your points and your streak are tied to this browser. Create an account with a passkey to be the same player on your phone and on your computer. There is no password and no email.
account.accountBody: Sign in on another device with the same passkey and you are this player there too. A second passkey keeps the account safe if you lose the first.
account.working: Follow your browser's steps to use the passkey.
account.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Open the site in an up to date browser to create an account or to sign in.
account.removeBody: You will not be able to sign in with it any more. Your password manager may keep its copy, which you can delete there.
account.mergeTitle: This device has scores of its own
account.mergeBody: They belong to the player this device had before you signed in. You can add them to your account. Where both solved the same daily puzzle, the earlier solve counts. That player then stops existing.
account.deleteLink: Delete my player and my data
account.deleteBody: Your name, nickname, scores, rooms and passkeys are removed from the server for good. Progress saved on this device stays until you clear the browser's data.

done.created: Account created. Use this passkey to sign in on your other devices.
done.merged: Done. Those scores are now on your account.

errors.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
errors.exists: This device or key already holds a passkey of this account.
errors.unknownPasskey: This passkey does not belong to any account here.
errors.refused: The passkey was not accepted. Try again.
errors.tooMany: This account has as many passkeys as it can hold. Remove one first.
errors.failed: Something went wrong with the passkey. Try again.
